2609.19176.title: Optimal Transport Metric Learning for Feature Alignment in Partially Supervised Segmentation
2609.19176.paper_summary: Multi-organ segmentation is often challenged by partially annotated datasets and domain shifts across different imaging sources. To address these limitations, we propose a two-stage learning framework that efficiently leverages partial supervision. In the first stage, the model learns from available annotations to produce accurate segmentations of annotated organs, establishing robust feature representations. In the second stage, we introduce learnable organ prototypes and a Sinkhorn-triplet loss to enforce organ-wise feature consistency across datasets. This encourages latent embeddings of the same organ to remain close, while increasing separation between different organs, even when annotations are missing. Our approach achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods on the BTCV dataset, while remaining computationally efficient. By explicitly aligning feature distributions rather than relying solely on pseudo-labels, the framework effectively mitigates domain shift, making it particularly suitable for medical image segmentation tasks with limited annotation resources.
2609.19176.paper_summary_zh: 多器官分割常常面臨部分標註數據集和不同成像來源之間的領域轉移挑戰。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了一種兩階段學習框架，能有效利用部分監督。在第一階段，模型從可用的標註中學習，以產生準確的標註器官分割，建立穩健的特徵表示。在第二階段，我們引入可學習的器官原型和Sinkhorn-triplet損失，以強化跨數據集的器官特徵一致性。這鼓勵同一器官的潛在嵌入保持接近，同時增加不同器官之間的分離，即使在缺少標註的情況下。我們的方法在BTCV數據集上的性能可與最先進的方法相媲美，同時保持計算效率。通過明確對齊特徵分佈，而不是僅僅依賴於偽標籤，該框架有效地減輕了領域轉移，使其特別適合於具有有限標註資源的醫學影像分割任務。
